description: This file defines a React component named 'Column' representing a column in a Kanban board. It manages inline editing of the column title, deletion, archiving, and displays a list of cards within the column. It interacts with context hooks for state updates and includes modal dialogs for delete confirmation.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new column title to ensure it is not empty and differs from the current title.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Starts the inline editing mode for the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the updated column title if valid, interacting with updateColumn API.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles key events in the title input, supporting Enter to save and Escape to cancel.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the column after confirmation.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.name: Column
ctags.pattern: /^function Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
